prompt:
A sprite sheet of 6 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 2 x 3 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) a STAR-LAMP way-lamp of a scholars' town on a high plateau: a slender square pillar of pale MARBLE with a carved star band, on top a small glass lantern cage of dark bronze shaped like a many-pointed star, UNLIT (dark glass); 2) the SAME marble pillar star-lamp LIT: the star-shaped glass lantern glowing a soft cool white-blue with a warm core; 3) a standing signpost of the plateau: a post of weathered grey stone with a pale marble plaque fixed across it (blank plaque, no letters), a small carved star on the post top; 4) a small bronze STAR LANTERN standing on the ground: a little star-shaped cage of dark bronze with glass panes, a ring handle (unlit, dark glass); 5) a notice board of a university town: a wide dark wooden board in a pale marble frame on two stone feet, a few blank papers and a star chart pinned to it (no letters); 6) the SAME small bronze star lantern LIT, its glass glowing soft white-blue with a warm core.
Scale: the way-lamp is about 50 art pixels tall, the signpost about 24 art pixels tall, the small lantern about 12 art pixels tall, the notice board about 30 art pixels wide; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels. Items 1 and 2 must be identical in size, shape and colours except that 2 is lit; items 4 and 6 likewise.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Exception: in the lit variants the glass may be bright, but no light spills onto anything around them.
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Create a single transparent-background sprite sheet of exactly 6 separate props for a top-down 3/4-view pixel-art JRPG (top surface and front face visible, upright props with bases at bottom). Grid is 2 columns x 3 rows, reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Large empty transparent gaps; no objects overlap or touch, none cropped. Row 1: (1) tall slender square pale-marble plateau scholars' town way-lamp pillar, carved star band, topped with small many-pointed star-shaped dark-bronze glass lantern cage, UNLIT dark glass; (2) EXACT SAME pillar, geometry and material colors as 1, except glass is lit with cool white-blue and a warm inner core. Row 2: (3) upright weathered-grey-stone post with horizontal blank pale-marble sign plaque, small carved star at top, no lettering; (4) little ground-standing many-pointed star-shaped dark-bronze lantern with dark glass panes and loop ring handle, UNLIT. Row 3: (5) university-town notice board, dark wood panel in pale-marble frame on two stone feet, several blank pinned papers and a star chart with only abstract stars and connecting lines, no letters; (6) EXACT SAME small bronze ground lantern as 4, same shape and material colors, except glass lit cool white-blue with warm core. Tall pillar ~50 native art pixels high, signpost ~24, little lantern ~12, board ~30 native art pixels wide. Consistent pixel scale throughout, crisp square enlarged art pixels ~6-8 output image pixels each; detailed high-end hand-placed HD pixel-art JRPG sprites, coherent small clusters, no anti-aliasing, blur, smooth shading, noise, dithering, or photographic texture. 4-6 flat shades per material, earthy rich hue-shifted ramps with saturated purple/red shadows and warm-yellow highlights. Neutral even overcast upper-left illumination; no cast shadows, no ground, no glow halos, no light spilling onto props or transparent background, no vignette. Only lit glass itself bright. Alpha-transparent background; no text, labels, or numbers.
